DESCRIPTION: Gas Clean oxygen purifier, 1/pk. The Agilent Gas Clean Filter System delivers clean gases, reducing the risks of column damage, sensitivity loss, and instrument downtime. Inserting a Gas Clean Filter System in the gas line immediately before the instrument inlet greatly reduces the level of impurities, thus improving trace analysis. Contaminants entering your GC column will also be reduced, which is critical for high temperature analysis and essential for longer column lifetime. Replacing the filters when they have reached absorption capacity ensures maximum protection of your GC columns and analytical hardware. The sensitive indicators change color, alerting you that the filter needs to be replaced. A Gas Clean Filter System allows you to use 99.996 % (4.6) pure helium instead of the more expensive 99.999 % (5.0) or 99.9999 % (6.0) grade, while still yielding high quality analytical results. The expected cost savings are 30 %.

Compared with glass heating lamps, such as infrared lamps or halogen heaters, they are especially resistant to dirt and vibration. PRODUCT_NAME: Spectrum Anti-Static Ionizer for Analytical A/B2 Series Balances
DESCRIPTION:
The DJ Series Anti-static Ionizer is used to remove excess ions (mainly positive, but also negative) from the load and elements of a balance and the immediate environment. Electric charges are neutralized (approaching net zero) during this process.

A lack of electrostatic neutrality in the air can lead to charge gradients of elements a small distance apart. This is a usual phenomenon for non-conducting materials such as plastic and glass, which are commonly found in balance components. Thus, the electrostatic influence can considerable affect measurement results, as represented in repeatability error or indication error.

Specifications:
• Distance sample (ions source): 5 to 50 cm
• Source of ions: Stainless steel
• Capacity: 3 kg
• Temperature of environment moisture: 0 to 40°, 10 to 80%
• Power supply: 110/230V, 50-60 Hz, 2W
